title: wb migrate carries prose inside a board section as items and reports nothing, so a sentence such as 'Nothing.' counts as work in flight
body:
`intent wb migrate` carries prose that sits inside a board section as items of that section's kind, and reports nothing. Ten on devbin's boards; carry-map reads the same ten. The same kind of paragraph ABOVE the first section is reported and dropped (devbin letter F), so the treatment depends on position rather than on what the text is. The consequence is in the counts: devbin/vc's DOING held one sentence, "Nothing. Paused at hv's word, 2026-09-09.", and the model now counts one item in flight where the truth is none. Devbin letter B, measured by both.

Found by devbin migrating its boards on Intent 3.0.3 (`d24487079`), sent through intent/vc on hv's routing, and ruled by hv on 2026-09-16 to be fixed in this release (hv decision 18). The full measurement record, with the instrument (`carry-map.sh`, driven red and green) and who measured what, is devbin `1824c75`, `intent/whiteboard/dc/.history/20260916/wb-upstream-defects-draft.md`.

**Shared cause with the other migrate carry issues filed with this one (devbin letters A, B, D, E and F):** `wb_item` is `id, node, kind, seq, text, state, archived_at, recorded_at, authored_at, updated_at`, and has no field for a board lead, a section lead, a sub-heading, a group, a table or a heading qualifier; the section a line renders under is derived from `kind`. Whether the answer is a richer model or a migrator that never coerces and reports everything it cannot carry is ruled once for all five.

Fix, corrected forward on 2026-09-16 to vc decision 20, which ruled for a louder migrator over a richer model. Section prose is carried as an item of its section's kind and reported `coerced:` with its `<file>:<line>`, so a sentence carried as an item is always named as one. It is not reported `uncarried:`: that word is kept for what the carry refuses, or drops on `--drop-uncarried`. As filed, this line asked for "a field that holds it, or an `uncarried:` report with its line", with a sentence never counted as an item.

**CLOSED 2026-09-16, landed on vc's word at 292414661 under vc decision 20 (the louder migrator).** Section prose is carried as an item and reported `coerced:` with its line, as the corrected Fix above says. A board's wip.md is kept byte for byte at `.history/pre-migration/wip.md`, so the sentence as written survives beside the item.
